"Break The Cycle" is a straight-up house record from two producers who know exactly how to work a dancefloor.

item.desc: From Barcelona Piem brings over 20 years of behind the decks to 'Danzatoria', drawing from the '90s house sound he grew up spinning. The EP is packed with groove, basslines and vocal chops that don't quit. Four tracks to bomb the dance floor. Direct and punchy, but still full of character.

item.desc:
For their final single before the release of their guaranteed-to-be-monumental 'Welcome to the Jungle' album, Speaker Louis and G-Class have teamed up with RjD on the buttons and the mighty Da Fuchaman on the mic.

All junglists and DnB heads know how irresistible authentic dancehall vocals combined with a body-moving riddim and weighty basslines can be, and this is a perfect example of the craft. We've now seen four cuts to judge the forthcoming album by, and there's only one possible verdict: it's going to be essential.

item.desc:
Mathias Kaden joins Nick Curly and Gorge's 8bit with the Static EP, bringing two upfront house cuts packed with his trademark energy. Static and Tribe lock into driving rhythms, tight grooves and that vibey Kaden feel, making for two proper prime-time tracks built for the floor.

Malikk and Bambi-S take the remixes in a deeper direction, stripping things back with minimal grooves and direct drums, while keeping the energy up. A strong 8bit appearance from one of Germany's most respected house artists.
